strategies.statement: API-first: every new inter-system exchange is a versioned, managed API by default
strategies.driver: Point-to-point integration debt slows every new product; ~40% of new-initiative effort is integration plumbing
strategies.target-outcome: All new inter-system exchange via managed APIs by 2026; legacy point-to-point reduced 50% by 2027

strategies.statement: Event-driven by default for state changes; synchronous request/response only where unavoidable
strategies.driver: Synchronous coupling is the dominant cause of cascading failure in the estate
strategies.target-outcome: All material state changes published as events on a shared backbone by 2027

strategies.statement: Contract-first: API and event schemas are designed and reviewed before implementation begins
strategies.driver: Implementation-first integrations leak internal models into shared contracts
strategies.target-outcome: Every published API has a reviewed schema; consumer codegen-ready by default

strategies.statement: Zero direct cross-zone traffic — all inter-zone integration flows through the managed gateway and broker
strategies.driver: Direct connections undermine centralised security, observability, and rate management
strategies.target-outcome: No production direct cross-zone connections by 2026; gateway/broker mediates everything

strategies.statement: Composability: integrations are designed for reuse, with stable contracts independent of consumers
strategies.driver: Single-consumer integrations multiply the integration surface and prevent ecosystem effects
strategies.target-outcome: A documented catalogue of reusable integration capabilities; new initiatives consume before they commission
